name: eggd_cgp-cnvkit-batch
title: eggd_cgp-cnvkit-batch
summary: Per-sample CNVkit analysis: coverage, PoN normalisation, CBS segmentation, integer CN calling, scatter plot and gene metrics for one tumour-only CGP panel sample.

inputSpec.name: tumour_bam
inputSpec.label: Tumour BAM
inputSpec.help: Mapped reads for the tumour sample. Chr-prefix chromosome names expected.

inputSpec.name: sample_id
inputSpec.label: Sample ID
inputSpec.help: Used as the output file stem for all outputs.

inputSpec.name: cn_reference
inputSpec.label: CNVkit PoN reference (.cnn)
inputSpec.help: PoN reference file produced by eggd_cgp-cnvkit-pon. Must have been built from coverage files generated with the same BED.

inputSpec.name: baits
inputSpec.label: Gene panel BED
inputSpec.help: Target intervals in BED format. Must be identical to the BED used to build the PoN reference. Chr-prefix chromosome names required.

inputSpec.name: diploid_parx_genome
inputSpec.label: Diploid pseudo-autosomal regions (genome build)
inputSpec.help: Passed as --diploid-parx-genome to cnvkit.py fix, segment, call, genemetrics and diagram (and to the sex checks), so chrX PAR1/PAR2 are treated as diploid in both sexes. Must be grch38 for Atlas CGP and must match the PoN build. If empty, the flag is omitted and a warning is logged: CNVkit then infers every sample as female.

inputSpec.name: purity
inputSpec.label: Tumour purity (deprecated, ignored)
inputSpec.help: Deprecated in 2.1.0 and ignored (DI-4121): CNVkit calls are made without --purity, as validated, and PURPLE is the source of absolute copy number. Kept so existing workflow wiring still runs; a warning is logged when it is supplied. To be removed in the next major version.

inputSpec.name: ploidy
inputSpec.label: Tumour ploidy (deprecated, ignored)
inputSpec.help: Deprecated in 2.1.0 and ignored (DI-4121): CNVkit calls are made without --ploidy, as validated. Kept so existing workflow wiring still runs; a warning is logged when it is supplied. To be removed in the next major version.

inputSpec.name: sex_override
inputSpec.label: Sex override (male or female)
inputSpec.help: Chromosomal sex to use instead of the LIMS letter: male, female, M or F (case-insensitive); any other value fails the job before analysis. Leave empty in routine use. Without it the sex comes from the LIMS letter, field 5 of the '-'-split sample ID (or of the BAM name when the sample ID has fewer than 5 fields): M gives -x male, F gives -x female, anything else no -x (CNVkit infers the sex from chrX). Must not be wired from PURPLE's inferred sex.

inputSpec.name: sample_sex
inputSpec.label: Sample sex (deprecated, ignored)
inputSpec.help: Deprecated in 2.1.0 and ignored (D2): it is wired from PURPLE's inferred sex, which must not override the LIMS sex. Use sex_override instead. Kept so existing workflow wiring still runs; a warning is logged when it is supplied. To be removed in the next major version.

inputSpec.name: drop_low_coverage
inputSpec.label: Filter out very-low-coverage bins before segmentation
inputSpec.help: When true, bins with very low read depth are removed before CBS segmentation. Passed as --drop-low-coverage to cnvkit.py segment. Recommended for FFPE samples. Default: true.

outputSpec.name: copy_ratios
outputSpec.label: Log2 copy ratios per bin (.cnr)
outputSpec.help: Per-bin log2 copy ratios after PoN normalisation. Input to downstream segmentation and visualisation.

outputSpec.name: segments
outputSpec.label: CBS segments (.cns)
outputSpec.help: CBS-segmented copy-number profile. One row per segment.

outputSpec.name: call_segments
outputSpec.label: Integer CN calls (.call.cns)
outputSpec.help: Segments annotated with copy-number calls from the log2 ratio thresholds (CNVkit fc65941 defaults: amplification >= 0.7, gain >= 0.2, loss < -0.25, deletion < -1.1). No purity or ploidy adjustment.

outputSpec.name: scatter_png
outputSpec.label: Genome-wide scatter plot (.png)
outputSpec.help: Genome-wide log2 copy-ratio scatter plot. Y-axis clamped to ±3 so losses at -1 to -1.5 are legible alongside high-amplitude amplifications. Amplified segments are indicated by segment lines at the scale edge.

outputSpec.name: diagram_pdf
outputSpec.label: Chromosome ideogram with gene labels (.pdf)
outputSpec.help: Chromosome-level ideogram with gene labels at CN-change sites (threshold 0.5 log2R, minimum 3 probes), with the same -x and --diploid-parx-genome as the calls.

outputSpec.name: genemetrics
outputSpec.label: Per-gene gain/loss metrics (.tsv)
outputSpec.help: Tab-separated gene-level summary: gene, log2R, depth, weight, CN, probes. Filtered to genes with |log2R| > 0.3 and ≥3 probes.
